## Security And Compliance Checklist (Required)
- [ ] SC-1 Scope and risk documented (authn/authz, data flow, trust boundaries, abuse cases)
- [ ] SC-2 Compliance mapping included (SOC2/ISO27001/PCI-DSS/internal controls)
- [ ] SC-3 Secure implementation verified (input validation, output encoding, least privilege, secure defaults)
- [ ] SC-4 Secrets and data protection verified (no hardcoded secrets, redaction in logs, encryption/masking as applicable)
- [ ] SC-5 Auditability confirmed (security-relevant actions logged with actor/action/target/timestamp)
- [ ] SC-6 Dependency hygiene passed (no unresolved critical/high vulnerabilities)
- [ ] SC-7 Security tests added/updated (authz boundaries, injection/fuzz, regression tests)
- [ ] SC-8 Negative tests executed (invalid tokens, privilege escalation attempts, malformed payloads)
- [ ] SC-9 CI gate result attached (all required checks passed, or approved exception with expiry)
- [ ] SC-10 Security reviewer sign-off completed before merge
